Name: Harim
Summary: Head of a family and of a priestly course that returned with Zerubbabel; his sons are named among those who took foreign wives, and a Harim sealed the covenant.
KeyVerses: Ezra 2:32; Ezra 2:39; Ezra 10:21; Ezra 10:31; Nehemiah 3:11; Nehemiah 7:35; Nehemiah 7:42; Nehemiah 10:5; Nehemiah 12:15
LifeLesson: One family's story can hold both return and repentance.
RelatedEvents: Cyrus's Decree and Return from Exile; Nehemiah Rebuilds the Wall
